name: page-assistant-monorepo
description: Embeddable, grounded, voice-capable page assistant that can read any web app and perform real actions for the user.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/widget && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/mcp && npm run build -w packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/widget packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json
